name: react-instantsearch-native
description: ⚡ Lightning-fast search for React Native, by Algolia

scripts.build: node init && yarn build:cjs && yarn build:es
scripts.build:cjs: node init && babel src --root-mode upward --extensions '.js,.ts,.tsx' --out-dir dist/cjs --ignore '**/__tests__/**/*','**/__mocks__/**/*' --quiet
scripts.build:es: node init && BABEL_ENV=es babel src --root-mode upward --extensions '.js,.ts,.tsx' --out-dir dist/es --ignore '**/__tests__/**/*','**/__mocks__/**/*' --quiet
